notes.title: Meet Mangui at PlayX4!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is damulchi. I'm back with news about Mangui after a long time.

Mangui will be participating in the [b]2025 PlayX4[/b] event! This event, taking place from May 22nd to 25th at KINTEX in Goyang-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea, will feature various game companies and numerous noteworthy indie games.

We'll be waiting for you at Developer Exhibition Zone G27. Everyone who visits our booth will receive a specially designed[b] Mangui card[/b], and those who complete the game tutorial will be given a one-of-a-kind [b]Mangui character stand[/b] as a gift!

We sincerely look forward to your visit.

notes.title: Mangui Full Release!
notes.notes:
[h2]Mangui Full Release![/h2]
[list]
[*] Hello everyone! Mangui has finally been officially released. We're excited to introduce 'Mangui', a turn-based roguelike game based on traditional Korean folklore and ghost stories.
[/list]
[h2]Early Access Improvements[/h2]
Mangui went through about 4 months of Early Access. Thanks to your valuable feedback during this period, the game has grown significantly. The main improvements include:
[list]
[*][b]Added Merchant Interactions[/b]: You can now defeat merchants, and by taking down these unfortunate peddlers, you can obtain special rewards.
[*][b]26 Achievements Added[/b]: An achievement system has been added to record all your challenges on Mangui Mountain.
[*][b]Gamepad Support[/b]: You can now play comfortably with a gamepad.
[*][b]English Translation Completed[/b]: Now you can enjoy the fascinating stories of Mangui in English.
[/list]
[h2]Soundtrack Release[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Mangui OST has been released! Own the captivating in-game music permanently.
[/list]
[h2]Launch Discount[/h2]
[list]
[*] To celebrate the official release, you can purchase the game at a 20% discount.
[/list]
We would like to thank everyone who participated in our Early Access journey. Without your gameplay and feedback, we wouldn't have reached this point. If you have any bug reports or improvement ideas in the future, please feel free to share them on our Discord server or Steam community.

We're waiting for you at Mangui. Make sure to return before the sun sets!

notes.title: Mangui Achievements added
notes.notes:
[h2]Achievements Added[/h2]
[list]
[*]An achievement system has been added to Mangui! Didn’t completing Mangui’s story give you enough of a sense of accomplishment? Record all your challenges with the new achievements!
[*]In this update, achievements are unlocked when each hero—including The Woodsman—completes the story.
[*]Achievements will be updated over several releases, with a variety of new achievements by character, difficulty, and specific conditions planned for the future.
[*]Please note: the newly added achievements do not reflect previous playthroughs. Even if you have already completed the story, you’ll need to play through it again to earn them.
[*]Caution! The achievement system may not work properly or might be reset. I’m just a small and pitiful game developer. This is my first time implementing an achievement system—if you encounter any issues, please let me know in the comments below.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Moving Around Obstacles' menu was displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the release of Mangui and going paid
notes.notes:
Hello. We have a message for you about Mangui. Thanks to your continued interest and feedback, we've been able to make a lot of improvements to Mangui. We're moving up the release of Mangui a little bit and launching it in early March. We also want to make it affordable before we go live.
[list]
[*]Mangui will go paid on 23 February.
[*]Users who have Mangui in their library before the paid transition will be able to continue playing without additional payment.
[/list]
If you have any questions, please contact us via Discord or email. Thank you.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.7
notes.notes:
[h2]Slay the Merchant and Obtain Unique Skills![/h2]
[list]
[*]Merchants now move freely instead of staying in fixed positions.
[*]You can still bump into Merchants to purchase items as before.
[*]However, if you attack a Merchant with skills twice or more, they will become hostile and attack the player.
[*]When you defeat a Merchant, you can acquire one of their sale items.
[*]You may also obtain their unique skills with a certain probability.
[list]
[*]Sub Skill 'Tiger's Fang' recovers 4 HP with a 25% chance when killing a target.
[*]Magic Skill 'Tiger's Breath' deals magical damage to the target and surroundings, inflicting Fear status. This skill never misses.
[*]Various other unique Merchant skills have been added.
[/list]
[*]Once hostile, a Merchant will periodically appear to chase the player throughout the story.
[*]The Merchant will definitely appear at the seventh and final pass.
[*]Merchants are very powerful, so choose wisely.
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Slightly increased Merchant appearance rate.
[*]ncreased Unending Blades trigger probability from 33% to 50%.
[*]Spiritual Braid Slash: Increased cooldown from 16 to 18 turns
[*]Spiritual Braid Slash: Increased maximum range from 3 to 4 tiles
[*]Bat Claw Strike: Increased cooldown from 14 to 16 turns
[*]Bat Claw Strike: Increased maximum range from 3 to 3.5 tiles
[*]Ram Charge: Increased maximum range from 3 to 3.5 tiles
[*]Dagger Hurl: Increased maximum range from 3 to 3.5 tiles
[*]Sal: Wind Slicer: Increased maximum range from 3 to 3.5 tiles
[*] Developer Note: All Charge Skills' maximum ranges have been slightly increased to make approaching enemies easier.
[/list]
[h2]Text Corrections[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed some words and typos in English dialogue.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dialogue wouldn't appear when discovering a chieftain at the edge of terrain.
[/list]

Please report bugs and balance feedback through Discord or developer email (damulchi@gmail.com).
